summary.text: Bernice Mireku-North is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 14 who has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mireku-North earned a B.A. in government and politics from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2003 and a J.D. from the Howard University School of Law in 2006.
She also completed a 2002 summer study abroad program in the comparative study of British and U.S. judicial systems at the University of Oxford.

Her career experience includes work as a law clerk in the Superior Court of the District of Columbia and the Prince George's County Circuit Court, as a contract attorney for TransPerfect Legal Solutions in Houston, and as an attorney in her own private practice.
Gov. Larry Hogan appointed Mireku-North to the House of Delegates on January 6, 2023, to replace Eric Luedtke.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Children, Youth, and Families Committee, the Fair Practices and State Personnel Oversight Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
